_comment: Limits for tools/compare_outputs.py; the first file name pattern that matches applies.
Measured on two runs of f198a2f (RTX 5060 Ti, 13 benchmark cases): preprocessing, segmentation and
patient-space meshes are bit-identical between runs, so they must match exactly. uniGradICON fine-tuning
is not deterministic, so everything after registration gets about 2x the largest run-to-run difference seen.
Distances and thicknesses are in mm.
